title: slicer-cli --list-flags
description: The JSON document --list-flags prints on stdout (run_list_flags in cli_list_flags.cpp): every flag this program takes, exit code 0. tests/test_list_flags.sh checks the documents it makes against this schema, so a change to the output must change this file too. Print settings are not here: every setting is a flag spelled with dashes, and --list-settings lists them.

flag.description: The flag as typed, with its dashes (--slice, -o).

aliases.description: Other spellings the official parser takes for the same flag.

source.description: official: a flag of the engine's own command line (its CLI definitions); slicer-cli: slicer-cli's own.

key.description: The official definition's key (export_3mf for --export-3mf). Official flags only.

supported.description: False when this binary refuses the flag with `refusal`.

refusal.description: The sentence the run prints when the flag is given. With supported false.

value.description: What the value is (FILE, N, LEVEL, ...). With takes_value true, where the definition names it.

type.description: The official definition's value type. Official flags only.

default.description: The default as the engine writes it.

works_in.description: The binaries of the package that take the flag, as --help states them.

note.description: A flag that is accepted and does nothing says so here.
